title: Ka Motion Sailing Adventure
blurb: Guests sail on the lower Laguna Madre enjoying a sunset dinner cruise with dishes inspired by Chef Carlos Martinez's travels through Mexico. The Snorkel Adventure Cruise offers a 2-hour experience at a shallow snorkel spot suitable for beginners and children, including a giant water slide and trampoline. Private sunset dinner cruises are also available for groups.
